description: Time series of online model state from persisted StrategyDecision rows. Params split into μ-, σ-, and other series per model.

options.content:
**Source:** `mm_events` (`StrategyDecision` on **Decisions topic**).

**Layout:** For each of **local_price_model**, **local_market_flow_model**, **global_market_flow_model**, and **global_price_model**, charts are split into **mu** (keys matching `^mu_`), **sigma** (keys matching `^sigma_`), and **other** top-level numeric params. Conditional mechanical-mixture price models also get dedicated nested-param charts for the sigmoid flow gate (`market_prob`, `market_resp`, `gate_beta[0/1]`) and component parameters (`market_beta`, `market_sigma`, `refresh_sigma`, `refresh_mean`). Global model **other** charts also include **`active_in_mpc`** (0/1).

Adjust **Exchange / Symbol / Decisions topic** to match persistence.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT payload, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ts DESC) AS rk
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE topic = '${decisions_topic}'
    AND event_type = 'StrategyDecision'
    AND exchange = '${exchange}'
    AND symbol = '${symbol}'
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(payload->'local_price_model'->>'kind', '') AS local_price_model_kind,
  COALESCE(payload->'local_market_flow_model'->>'kind', '') AS local_market_flow_model_kind,
  COALESCE(payload->'global_market_flow_model'->>'kind', '') AS global_market_flow_model_kind,
  COALESCE(payload->'global_price_model'->>'kind', '') AS global_price_model_kind
FROM latest
WHERE rk = 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time",
       ('local_price_model.' || kv.key) AS metric,
       (kv.value #>> '{}')::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e,
LATERAL jsonb_each(COALESCE(e.payload->'local_price_model'->'params', '{}'::jsonb)) AS kv(key, value)
WHERE e.topic = '${decisions_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'StrategyDecision'
  AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND jsonb_typeof(kv.value) = 'number'
  AND kv.key ~ '^mu_'
ORDER BY 1

WITH params AS (
  SELECT e.ts,
         'local_price_model'::text AS model_key,
         COALESCE(e.payload->'local_price_model'->'params', '{}'::jsonb) AS p
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.topic = '${decisions_topic}'
    AND e.event_type = 'StrategyDecision'
    AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
    AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
)
SELECT ts AS "time",
       model_key || '.market_prob' AS metric,
       CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(p->>'market_prob', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(p->>'market_prob', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM params
WHERE p->>'market_prob' IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT ts AS "time",
       model_key || '.market_resp' AS metric,
       CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(p->>'market_resp', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(p->>'market_resp', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM params
WHERE p->>'market_resp' IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT params.ts AS "time",
       params.model_key || '.gate_beta[' || (gb.idx - 1)::text || ']' AS metric,
       (gb.value #>> '{}')::double precision AS value
FROM params
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(params.p->'gate_beta', '[]'::jsonb))
  WITH ORDINALITY AS gb(value, idx)
WHERE jsonb_typeof(gb.value) = 'number'
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", model AS metric,
  CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['models', model, 'nll'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['models', model, 'nll'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(ARRAY['local_price','local_market_flow','global_market_flow','global_price']) AS model
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND e.payload #>> ARRAY['models', model, 'nll'] IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1

SELECT model AS model,
  COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['models', model, 'skip_reason'], '') AS skip_reason,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(ARRAY['local_price','local_market_flow','global_market_flow','global_price']) AS model
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND e.payload #>> ARRAY['models', model, 'skip_reason'] IS NOT NULL
  AND e.payload #>> ARRAY['models', model, 'skip_reason'] <> ''
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY count DESC

list.definition:
SELECT exchange
FROM (
  SELECT exchange, max(ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM (
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
    AND event_type IN ('StrategyDecision', 'ControllerDiagnostics', 'JointTargetBook')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT gates.key AS exchange, e.ts
  FROM mm_events e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(
    COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates','venue_gates'], '{}'::jsonb)
  ) AS gates(key, value)
  WHERE e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
    AND gates.key IS NOT NULL
    AND gates.key <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT payload #>> ARRAY['local_market','exchange'] AS exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'JointStrategyFrame'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT payload #>> ARRAY['global_market','exchange'] AS exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'JointStrategyFrame'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'MarketEvent'
    AND exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_market_facts
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND exchange <> ''
  ) sources
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND exchange <> ''
  GROUP BY exchange
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC
